code_review: The service passes RGB and instruction to DiceLatentPredictor.predict without parsing a target skill from instruction.
The predictor obtains goal_embedding from learned GoalHead over backbone visual/text hidden features.
The reported skill is the nearest canonical vector by learned embedding distance; it is not assigned from requested pip count.
The transmitted continuous goal embedding is applied unchanged; independent audit verified 36 accepted continuous commands in this cell.
The study semantic module supplies the common physical-skill-ID contract, with no layout table or scorer target.
interpretation: The 31 wrong-binding false stops all report the original same-number skill association. This is consistent with reliance on the native training association, not evidence of a service-side hardcoded remap.
limitations: Post-hoc diagnostic of one permutation and one native-layout-trained checkpoint.
Bare VLM sees only current RGB and instruction; Astra also receives action/observation history and noisy feedback and can probe skills.
This comparison measures complete-system layout transfer. It does not isolate model weights, fine-tuning itself, or memorization as an exclusive cause.
Without action history or a stable physical-face reference, a new printed-count-to-motor-ID mapping may be ambiguous from a single view.
No checkpoint or prompt was tuned on these formal outcomes.
